references.text: The judges ask sarcastically where the foreign gods Israel served are when they need help, the same rhetorical question as in Deuteronomy.
Elijah mocks the prophets of Baal by asking where their god is, a similar rhetorical question about the powerlessness of false gods.
The psalmist describes enemies who ask 'Where is your God?', the same mocking question about God's presence.
The nations ask 'Where is their God?', the same theme of enemies doubting the power of Israel's God.
The peoples ask 'Where is their God?', a similar mocking question from the nations.
The Lord is called 'my rock' (צור), the same image of God as refuge and protection.
God is described as rock and refuge, the same theme of seeking shelter in God.
The peoples will ask 'Where is their God?', the same rhetorical question expressing doubt about God's power.
